233655961_db649147.text: The thalamocortical pathway consists of GABAergic neurons that project from the thalamic reticular nucleus (nRT) toward the ventral basalis (VB), generating an inhibitory "loop" for a self-modulation of the nRT. GABAergic neurons of the nRT receive the glutamatergic stimulation from the VB and the cortico-thalamic fibers that are projected from the layer six of the cerebral cortex. In this "loop context," GABA A receptors are in glutamatergic thalamocortical and cortico-thalamic neurons, as well as in the GABAergic neurons themselves (McCormick et al., 1997) .
